title: The Bitcoin ETF exit

lines: out of Bitcoin ETFs this month.
Bitcoin ETF buyer is now underwater —
An ETF made crypto easy to buy —
and just as easy to stampede out of.

source_line: Source: The Block & CoinMarketCap — spot Bitcoin ETF flows, Nov 2026
caption:
Investors pulled about $3.5 billion out of U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs this month — the biggest monthly exit since February.

Bitcoin slid to around $91,000 on Thanksgiving Day with U.S. markets closed, heading for its worst month since 2022 and sitting well below its record near $126,000. One analyst says the average Bitcoin ETF buyer is now underwater.

A fund made crypto easy to buy inside a retirement or brokerage account — and November showed it's just as easy for that money to rush back out.

My take: the ETF didn't make Bitcoin less volatile. It just gave more ordinary savers a front-row seat to the swings.
